NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Daily calorie: maintain slight surplus on heavy-training non-flow days (+200 kcal), maintenance on luteal days, slight deficit not recommended during flow."
    - "Protein: 1.6..2.0 g/kg bodyweight daily, distributed across meals."
    - "Carbohydrate: higher on non-flow heavy days (3..5 g/kg), moderate during luteal (2..3 g/kg), focus on low-GI carbs during flow for steady energy."
    - "Fat: 0.8..1.2 g/kg daily, include anti-inflammatory sources (omega-3 rich foods)."
    - "Hydration: aim for 2.5..3 L/day; increase during flow and workouts. Include electrolytes (sodium, magnesium) if cramps present."
    - "Micronutrients: emphasize iron (heme sources or supplement if low), magnesium (nuts, leafy greens or 200..400 mg supplement at night), calcium, vitamin D."
    - "Meal timing: include a carbohydrate + protein snack 60..90 minutes pre-workout on non-flow days; during flow prioritize smaller frequent meals if appetite reduced."
    - "Caffeine: can be used moderately pre-workout on non-flow days; avoid large doses during flow if it worsens cramps or anxiety."
    - "Anti-cramp strategies: consider magnesium 200..400 mg nightly during luteal and flow phases, heat therapy and gentle movement on flow days; discuss pharmacologic options with GP if needed."
    - "Anti-inflammatory foods: include oily fish, walnuts, flaxseed, berries, leafy greens, turmeric and ginger."
    - "Sodium: do not restrict excessively on flow days if experiencing dizziness or heavy bleeding; include salty snacks if needed."

    - "Iron supplement only if bloodwork indicates deficiency — coordinate with GP."
    - "Vitamin D if deficient per blood test."
  NOTES:

    - "Flow days (cycle days 1..3) use reduced intensity, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping, and low-impact HIIT/power alternatives."
    - "Power (jumping) is scheduled on non-flow days; flow-safe power uses kettlebell swings and step-ups instead of jumps."

NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Daily calorie: maintain slight surplus on heavy-training non-flow days (+200 kcal), maintenance on luteal days, slight deficit not recommended during flow."
    - "Protein: 1.6..2.0 g/kg bodyweight daily, distributed across meals."
    - "Carbohydrate: higher on non-flow heavy days (3..5 g/kg), moderate during luteal (2..3 g/kg), focus on low-GI carbs during flow for steady energy."
    - "Fat: 0.8..1.2 g/kg daily, include anti-inflammatory sources (omega-3 rich foods)."
    - "Hydration: aim for 2.5..3 L/day; increase during flow and workouts. Include electrolytes (sodium, magnesium) if cramps present."
    - "Micronutrients: emphasize iron (heme sources or supplement if low), magnesium (nuts, leafy greens or 200..400 mg supplement at night), calcium, vitamin D."
    - "Meal timing: include a carbohydrate + protein snack 60..90 minutes pre-workout on non-flow days; during flow prioritize smaller frequent meals if appetite reduced."
    - "Caffeine: can be used moderately pre-workout on non-flow days; avoid large doses during flow if it worsens cramps or anxiety."
    - "Anti-cramp strategies: consider magnesium 200..400 mg nightly during luteal and flow phases, heat therapy and gentle movement on flow days; discuss pharmacologic options with GP if needed."
    - "Anti-inflammatory foods: include oily fish, walnuts, flaxseed, berries, leafy greens, turmeric and ginger."
    - "Sodium: do not restrict excessively on flow days if experiencing dizziness or heavy bleeding; include salty snacks if needed."
